selected_evidence.requirement: Restore config.json from the latest backup

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve all other current inventory files

Healthy pre-restart state was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 661f4609-9d90-477e-bb22-6f91a5e8ec1a to a6d9bbba-9be3-49c5-81d7-143f5f3f951b, and networking, chronyd, vsock-agent, sshd, address/listener state, valid JSON, restored checksum, and preserved current.txt all recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
other=/srv/inventory/data/current.txt
[ -f "$backup" ]
[ -f "$target" ]
[ -f "$other" ]
before_other_hash=$(sha256sum "$other" | awk '{print $1}')
before_other_meta=$(stat -c '%i|%s|%Y|%a|%u:%g' "$other")
source_hash=$(tar -xOzf "$backup" config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
stage=$(mktemp -d /srv/inventory/data/.restore.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xzf "$backup" -C "$stage" config.json
[ -f "$stage/config.json" ]
staged_hash=$(sha256sum "$stage/config.json" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$staged_hash" = "$source_hash" ]
mv -f "$stage/config.json" "$target"
after_target_hash=$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')
after_other_hash=$(sha256sum "$other" | awk '{print $1}')
after_other_meta=$(stat -c '%i|%s|%Y|%a|%u:%g' "$other")
[ "$after_target_hash" = "$source_hash" ]
[ "$after_other_hash" = "$before_other_hash" ]
[ "$after_other_meta" = "$before_other_meta" ]
printf 'restored_from=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'backup_config_sha256=%s\n' "$source_hash"
printf 'restored_config_sha256=%s\n' "$after_target_hash"
printf 'other_file_before_sha256=%s\n' "$before_other_hash"
printf 'other_file_after_sha256=%s\n' "$after_other_hash"
printf 'other_file_metadata_before=%s\n' "$before_other_meta"
printf 'other_file_metadata_after=%s\n' "$after_other_meta"
printf 'target_metadata='; stat -c '%n|%F|%s|%Y|%y|%a|%U:%G' "$target"
printf 'inventory_entries='; find /srv/inventory/data -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print | sort | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'

printf 'json_tools:\n'
for tool in jq python3 python ruby perl; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s=%s\n' "$tool" "$(command -v "$tool")"; fi; done
printf 'inventory_entries_after_cleanup:\n'
find /srv/inventory/data -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec stat -c '%n|%F|%s|%Y|%a|%U:%G' {} \; | sort
